---
name: Bug Report
about: The linter, the conformance harness, or the spec text did something wrong
title: '[bug] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## What I ran

Paste the exact command (e.g. `npx packstruct lint packs/ --deep`).

## What happened

The output you got, in full if it is short. If the linter refused a pack, paste the refusal line.

## What I expected

What you thought would happen, and why.

## Environment

- OS: [e.g. macOS 14, Ubuntu 24.04]
- Node version: [e.g. 20.11]
- packstruct version (`npx packstruct --version`): [e.g. 1.1.0]

## Anything else

A minimal `pack.json` or a link to the repo that reproduces it is the single most useful thing you can add.
